webhooks.detail: Webhooks API: create/get/delete webhook subscriptions to event topics (scopes webhooks:read/webhooks:write).

evidence.quote: A list of topics to subscribe to.

sandbox.detail: Getting-started guide has optional step to create a sandbox/test account; Klaviyo test accounts do not need paid plan (pricing not verified).

rate_limits.summary: Per-account fixed windows, burst 1s + steady 1min; tiers XS 1/s,15/m up to XL 350/s,3500/m; per-endpoint

evidence.quote: use a fixed-window rate limiting algorithm with two distinct windows: burst (1-second window) and steady (1-minute window).
